تنتقلن (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقِلْنَ (tantaqilna) /tan.ta.qil.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
# تُنْتَقَلْنَ (tuntaqalna) /tun.ta.qal.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
